data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD6: Extend BLOCK-gate AND-logic in arbiter.py: BLOCK requires severity ∈ {critical, important} AND defense rejected/absent AND cycle_num ≤ max_cycles AND impact_class ∈ 8-category floor (impact_class='none' MUST NOT BLOCK regardless of severity).

## TDD Requirement
Add tests to tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py:

1. test_block_ruling_with_impact_class_none_reclassified_to_defer
   - Given: ruling with severity=critical, ruling=BLOCK, impact_class='none', cycle within max
   - When: _enforce_cove_fallback or new _enforce_impact_class_floor applied
   - Then: ruling reclassified to DEFER, rationale mentions impact_class floor

2. test_block_ruling_with_impact_class_in_floor_preserved
   - Given: ruling with severity=critical, ruling=BLOCK, impact_class='security_vulnerability'
   - When: validation applied
   - Then: ruling remains BLOCK

3. test_compute_ruling_from_fixture_applies_impact_class_floor
   - Given: fixture with arbiter_ruling.ruling=BLOCK, impact_class='none', cycle=1, max=4
   - When: compute_ruling_from_fixture called
   - Then: result['ruling'] == 'DEFER' (floor reclassified)

## Implementation Notes
Add new helper `_enforce_impact_class_floor(ruling)` in arbiter.py:

```python
def _enforce_impact_class_floor(ruling: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    \"\"\"Reclassify BLOCK to DEFER when impact_class is 'none' (outside 8-category floor).\"\"\"
    if ruling.get("ruling") == "BLOCK" and ruling.get("impact_class") == "none":
        result = dict(ruling)
        result["ruling"] = "DEFER"
        original_rationale = result.get("rationale", "")
        result["rationale"] = (
            f"impact_class floor: impact_class='none' is outside 8-category BLOCK floor — "
            f"BLOCK reclassified to DEFER. Original: {original_rationale}"
        )
        return result
    return ruling
```

Call _enforce_impact_class_floor after _enforce_cove_fallback in dispatch_arbiter (per-ruling) and in compute_ruling_from_fixture. Update agent prompt's BLOCK-Gate AND-Logic to explicitly cite the 4th condition (impact_class ∈ floor).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] BLOCK reclassified to DEFER when impact_class='none'
  Verify: python -m pytest \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py -k "impact_class_none_reclassified" 2>&1 | grep -q passed
- [ ] BLOCK preserved when impact_class is in floor
  Verify: python -m pytest \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py -k "impact_class_in_floor_preserved" 2>&1 | grep -q passed

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
